sources.description: Here are my top players in the 2026 NFL Draft. The board is a bit skewed towards positions the Eagles are prioritizing, so it’s heavy on offensve/defensive linemen and wide receivers. Overall, it’s a class whose richness is in the middle. As it stands, the Eagles’ wealth of mid-round picks should turn into great value […]
